quotes: radiates a tangible Divine Empyreal aura (see Heaven and Earth, Divine Auras) with a rating equal to his True Faith Score minus 4

entries.title: Experiencing Divine Ascent
entries.summary: A Divine-aligned character who gains enough Warping Points in a single event rolls to resist Divine Ascent, and on a failure undergoes Divine Form (contemplatives) or Divine Gloom (monistics) and takes extra Warping Points equal to the margin of failure.
quotes: Presence + Concentration (or Meditation) + Stress die vs. Warping Score + Warping Points gained + True Faith Score local aura + stress die (no botch)

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.63 Divine Ascent

entries.title: Divine Warping and the Contemplative Mystic
entries.requires: Contemplative mystic who has suffered Divine Form
entries.summary: Summarizes the permanent changes of Divine Form for a contemplative mystic: added Magic Resistance, a Soak bonus, a Penetration bonus, extra botch dice for impious acts, automatic wounds for sin and a continuous Commanding Aura.
quotes: The character gains a Penetration Bonus equal to her Warping Score, with an additional bonus equal to her (True Faith Score multiplied by 5).
The character gains a bonus to physical Soak totals equal to the Magic Resistance Total divided by 5

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.64 Divine Form

entries.title: Divine Warping and the Monistic Mystic
entries.requires: Monistic mystic who has suffered Divine Gloom
entries.summary: Summarizes Divine Gloom for a monistic mystic: Warping Points convert into experience in Dominion Lore and Holy Abilities at the cost of mundane Ability experience, with a bonus against Celestial Disorientation and attraction of supernatural beings.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.63 Divine Gloom
Realms of Power: The Divine p.14 Celestial Disorientation

entries.title: The Divine Ascent (overview)
entries.summary: Holy mystics undergo a unique form of Warping, the Divine Ascent, in one of three forms (Gloom, Form, Unity) that replace the normal Effects of Warping; there is no final Ascent, and characters with only True Faith get generic Warping.
quotes: which replace the normal "Effects of Warping" rules

entries.title: Divine Ascension roll
entries.summary: When a holy character gains two or more Warping Points from one event they roll to resist being lifted into the Divine; failure triggers a form of the Ascent and extra Warping Points equal to the margin of failure.
quotes: DIVINE ASCENSION: Presence + Concentration (or Meditation) + stress die vs. Warping Score + Number of Warping Points Gained + True Faith Score + local aura + stress die (no botch)

entries.title: Experiencing the Ascent (duration)
entries.summary: Describes the visionary experience of the Ascent, how long it lasts (in days, later months), True Faith shortening it, and what happens to the character's body meanwhile.
quotes: BASE ASCENT TIME: (Warping Score + Warping Points gained) in days
A character with True Faith subtracts his Faith Score from the total (although the minimum remains 1 day).

entries.title: Divine Gloom
entries.summary: The Gloom form trades mundane knowledge for holy understanding: Warping Points convert into experience in holy Abilities while an equal amount is lost from mundane Abilities, and the character attracts Invisible World beings.
quotes: The character must lose the same number of Experience Points that he gained from Warping from Abilities with a mundane focus

entries.title: Divine Form
entries.summary: The Form variant makes the character a commanding, near-angelic presence with Magic Resistance and Penetration from Warping Score and Faith, but sinful acts bring extra botch dice and wounds.
quotes: The character's Penetration is equal to his Warping Score, and gains an additional bonus equal to his Faith Score multiplied by 5.
a number of additional botch dice equal to the character's Warping Score multiplied by three

entries.title: Divine Unity
entries.summary: The Unity variant makes the character personify one virtue, boosting a matching Personality Trait by Warping Score and exerting Holy Influence on those nearby and on the aura's Temper.
quotes: The Warped character adds his Warping Score to a Personality Trait determined by the virtue he is personifying

entries.title: The Virtues (for Divine Unity)
entries.summary: Reference list of Christian moral and theological virtues a Divine Unity character may personify.

entries.title: Islamic Virtues (for Divine Unity)
entries.summary: Additional Islamic virtues suitable for a character experiencing Divine Unity.

entries.title: Bear Island: Chytus Harbor (Gegenees external vis boulders)
entries.summary: A Faerie aura site where the Gegenees keep their external vis in boulders; the number of vis-holding boulders is scaled to the saga's power level and moving or threatening them provokes an assault.
quotes: How many of these hold vis depends on how many Gegenees you need for your saga: 50 for a low powered saga, 200 for a medium powered saga, and 1,000 or more for a high powered saga.

entries.title: Bear Island: Temenos of Dindyméné (dual Magic and Faerie aura)
entries.summary: A sacred grove holding overlapping Magic and Faerie auras, where the older Magic aura normally suppresses the Faerie one except on certain anniversaries and festival dates, and which is the doorway to a Magic regio and a Faerie regio.
quotes: The temenos has both a Magic aura of 3 and a Faerie aura of 3.
At certain times of the year, however, the Faerie aura increases to 4 and suppresses the Magic aura.

entries.title: Bear Island: The Jasonian Way (faerie regio path)
entries.summary: A faerie regio path to the summit of Mount Dindymon with fixed travel time, entrances in weaker or stronger Faerie auras at each end, and a vast faerie forest of Gegenees off the path.
quotes: It takes four hours to travel the trail, no matter what the characters do to expedite this process.

entries.title: Bear Island: Faerie Regio of Dindyméné
entries.summary: The Faerie regio behind the temenos, home of the Idaian Daktyls, stacked with a Magic aura and Magic regio.
quotes: The Faerie regio has a Faerie aura of 6.

entries.title: Bear Island: Magic Regio of Dindyméné
entries.summary: An enlarged, uninhabited Magic regio whose peace gives visitors a temporary Calm personality trait unless they have Magic-realm supernatural abilities, and which grows Herbam and Terram vis each year.
quotes: With a Magic aura of 6, the Magic regio is an enlarged copy of the Temenos of Dindyméné.
Entering characters gain a new Personality Trait, Calm +2, unless they have supernatural abilities derived from the Magic realm, which includes the Gift.

entries.title: Cursewood: The Regio (entry only when led by Wyzwanie)
entries.summary: The level 7 Magic regio containing Regulus' encampment, which may be entered only if the spirit allows it by letting the worthy cross the wall.
quotes: Regulus' encampment is now hidden in a Magic regio of level 7.

entries.title: Farne Islands: Inner Farne (Divine aura and miraculous barley vis)
entries.summary: A Divine aura island with a miraculous spring and a one-month barley crop from which Creo vis can be harvested if the grain can be ripened supernaturally fast and protected from the magical birds.
quotes: Divine aura 2, rising to 4 in the chapel.

entries.title: Farne Islands: The Wideopens (gut hazard and tunnel regio)
entries.summary: Unconsecrated burials make the dead vulnerable to necromancy, a gut needs ship handling rolls in bad weather, and a tunnel inside a Magic aura 2 regio opens only occasionally.
quotes: a ship handling roll must be made every 100 paces in all but the calmest of weathers

entries.title: Farne Islands: The Bush (surviving immersion by faith)
entries.summary: A character of strong faith stranded here suffers no ill effects and can survive the tidal immersion by praying with a Stamina + Concentration roll; a year here can form part of a Test of Faith.
quotes: If he prays during the hour that the island is totally immersed (requiring a Stamina + Concentration roll of Ease Factor 6) then he can survive without air to breathe.

related.text: Realms of Power: the Divine p.59 Test of Faith

entries.title: Example of Creating a Devout Character
entries.requires: Christian character with a positive Personality Trait: Pious
entries.summary: A worked example of assigning starting Devotion Points to saints for a pious lay character, including the extra Devotion Points a relic can grant.

entries.title: Devotion
entries.requires: Christian character with a positive Personality Trait: Pious (or the Pious Personality Flaw)
entries.summary: Introduces Devotions to particular saints as a Divine-aligned Ability-like statistic bought with separate Devotion Points rather than ordinary experience, and gives the character-generation rule for how many Devotions and Devotion Points a pious Christian starts with.
quotes: Devotions advance as an Ability, but do not use normal, generalized Experience Points, instead relying on a dedicated form of experience points called Devotion Points.
may spend Devotion Points equal to the positive score in that trait to establish Devotions

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.87 Invoking a saint

entries.title: The Benefits of Devotion
entries.summary: A Devoted character can invoke any saint he has Devotion in; the Devotion score is added to the invocation roll. Also explains sacramentals as ordinary invocations of an appropriate saint, which avoid the unknown-saint penalty.
quotes: Communication + Charm + modifiers + a simple die vs. 15 + a simple die
the –15 penalty for invoking an unknown saint is not applied

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.87 Invoking a saint

entries.title: Relics & Devotion
entries.requires: Possession of a relic of a saint
entries.summary: A carried or tended relic of a saint adds to the Devotion Total when asking that saint to intercede, once a day, and also removes the unfamiliar-saint penalty.
quotes: Relic Bonus: (Faith Points in relic) x 2 bonus to Devotion Total

entries.title: The Costs of Devotion
entries.summary: A Devoted character must observe the saint's feast day each year, losing the day for seasonal activities, and loses Devotion Points if he fails to do so.
quotes: A character failing to celebrate the festival of his saint in some manner will lose at least three Devotion Points

entries.title: Gaining Devotion Points
entries.summary: Lists the activities that earn Devotion Points in play (seasons of prayer, endowing churches, guild membership, shrine visits, sponsoring art, studying hagiographies, advancing the saint's cultus, witnessing miracles, processions, pilgrimage, visions) and the usual award for each.
quotes: Spending a season engaged in prayer and meditation at a shrine to a saint earns 5 Devotion Points.
grants a number of Devotion Points equal to the Aesthetic Quality of the final artwork
worth Devotion Points equal to Quality/2

related.text: The Church Ch.3 Petitioning the Church

entries.title: False Devotion
entries.summary: Devotion can be directed at an unrecognised saint or even a mistaken entity of another realm without heresy, because dulia is not worship; true worship (latria) of anything but God is a serious sin.

entries.title: Traveling Auras
entries.requires: Being type: Faerie with a power permitting travel
entries.summary: Some powerful faeries carry their glamour with them, transforming the surrounding land to suit their motif; the changes fade as the faerie leaves, but the consequences of human actions remain.
quotes: The changes made when the glamour of the faerie lays over an area are not permanent

entries.title: Aura Conflicts: Faeries in Other Realms' Auras
entries.summary: A faerie in an area dominated by another Realm, without admittance, must draw its glamour back into itself, which limits its powers' Range; with admittance it creates a small pocket of Faerie.
quotes: faerie characters cannot use powers with Ranges greater than Touch until they have been given leave to do so, unless they have Arcane Connections to the targets

entries.title: Gaining Admittance
entries.summary: Lists the traditional ways a faerie gains leave to use its glamour in areas of another Realm: terra nullius, a recognized right, an invitation, agreeing to a code, paying a price, or contesting ownership; covenants require the Aegis of the Hearth token.
quotes: only participation in the Aegis of the Hearth ritual, and possession of one of the tokens this creates, allows a faerie to use its powers without facing the formidable magical resistance common to covenants

entries.title: Keeping Home Wonderful
entries.summary: Three ways a faerie protects its demesne while absent (leave a steward, leave its spiritual anchor, or restrict access to set times) and the aura a visitor finds if a steward is left.
quotes: If they enter an area kept by a steward, then its aura will be (steward's Might/5).

entries.title: Extended Glamour
entries.summary: Power letting a faerie be aware of everything in its domain, with the domain's size set by the faerie's Might Score, and yielding vis each year.
quotes: The faerie's Might score determines the size of area possible: a Room (5–10 Might), a Structure (15–25 Might), or a standard Boundary (30+ Might).
The area controlled by the faerie can produce a yearly harvest of (Might/10) pawns of vis

entries.title: Tinted Auras
entries.requires: Sympathy Trait (from a Virtue or Faerie Warping)
entries.summary: Rules for tinting a Faerie aura so that everyone within gains temporary Personality Traits, including the roll, how long tints last and combining tints.
quotes: stress die + Presence + Concentration
In a tinted aura, every character is strangely drawn to things that are associated with the tint, and repelled by things that are not.

entries.title: Tinting an Aura Table
entries.requires: Sympathy Trait (from a Virtue or Faerie Warping)
entries.summary: Table of Ease Factors for tinting a Faerie aura to a given Personality Trait value.

entries.title: Adjuration (Holy Power)
entries.summary: The Power of summoning, controlling and banishing supernatural creatures, and how Invocation and Purity apply to it.

entries.title: Blessing (Holy Power)
entries.summary: The Power of protecting and aiding a target by dedicating it to God, and how Invocation and Meditation apply to it.

entries.title: Cursing (Holy Power)
entries.summary: The Power of bringing ruin on God's enemies, and how Invocation and Purity differ in the curses they produce.

entries.title: Intervention (Holy Power)
entries.summary: The Power of making God's will visible in the physical world through signs, transformations and healing, and how Meditation and Purity apply to it.

entries.title: Transcendence (Holy Power)
entries.summary: The Power of overcoming the limits of body and mind, including spiritual travel, and how Meditation and Purity apply to it.

entries.title: Understanding (Holy Power)
entries.summary: The Power of receiving holy visions and hidden knowledge, including the risk of confusion on repeated questions.

entries.title: Wonders (Holy Power)
entries.summary: The Power of conjuring items, creatures and forces of nature through Invocation, and what happens on a tragedy of hubris.

entries.title: Miracles (overview)
entries.summary: Introduces the optional miracle rules: miracles come directly from God, cannot be overcome by magic or other powers, and differ from saints' miracles and from learned holy powers.
quotes: The following mechanics for miracles are optional.

entries.title: Praying for Miracles
entries.summary: To pray for a miracle, a character with a Faith Point picks an effect, spends the point and rolls against the power's level; Faith Points can boost the roll, groups may pray together, and miracles have infinite Penetration.
quotes: PRAYING FOR A MIRACLE: True Faith Score + Concentration + Aura + Stress Die
Faith Points may be spent to increase this roll, adding +3 for each point spent
Miracles have an infinite Penetration: a successful miracle transcends all other powers.

entries.title: Miraculous Special Effects
entries.summary: Miracles are usually slow and subtle; asking for faster or more trivial results raises the miracle's level by a modifier.
quotes: Add the modifier to the miracle's level.

entries.title: Miracle Timeliness modifiers
entries.summary: Table of level modifiers for how quickly a miracle manifests after the prayer, from immediate to a generation.
quotes: Immediate (instantly to a few hours): +10
Generation (not longer than fifteen years): –20

entries.title: Miracle Need modifiers
entries.summary: Level modifiers reflecting how desperate, deserving or righteous the prayer is, from calamitous need to impious requests.
quotes: Calamitous (supplicant or the subjects of the prayer are in desperate personal need, such assault from supernatural forces): –15
Impious (supplicant is a pagan, infidel, or unbeliever, or the request is motivated by sin, such as pride or greed): +20

entries.title: Botching a Prayer
entries.summary: A botched prayer costs the character their Faith Points for a time, or blocks all prayers and saint invocations if they had none; it may also provoke a tragedy of hubris.
quotes: Botching a prayer roll results in the temporary loss of all Faith Points for a number of weeks equal to botches scored.

entries.title: Storyguiding Miracles
entries.summary: Advice that miracles are negotiated between player and storyguide before the roll, with the storyguide having final say, to avoid overshadowing magi; failed rolls may bring lesser aid.
quotes: God's hand cannot be forced, even by a lucky roll.

entries.title: Miraculous Effects
entries.summary: The core system for holy characters: combine a Method with a Power to design an effect, roll against its level, and risk a tragedy of hubris on failure.
quotes: EFFECT TOTAL: simple die + (Characteristic) + (Method) + (Power) + Aura Bonus
They may substitute their (Faith score x 10) for their effect total when determining if they would suffer a tragedy of hubris.

entries.title: Tragedies of Hubris
entries.summary: Table of minor, major and ultimate tragedies that can befall a holy character who fails an effect roll, by how far the total fell short.
quotes: MINOR TRAGEDY (–1 TO –10)
MAJOR TRAGEDY (–11 TO –20)
ULTIMATE TRAGEDY (–21 OR MORE)

entries.title: Methods and Traditions
entries.summary: Describes the three Holy Methods, Invocation, Meditation and Purity, and the Characteristic each typically relies on.

entries.title: Powers and Effects
entries.summary: How a Power's effects are designed: compute range, duration and target like Hermetic magic, replace Arcane Connections with holy connections, and add levels instead of rituals.
quotes: Instead, the Level is increased by 20.
holy effects generally add four magnitudes for a Boundary target, Year duration, or permanent duration

entries.title: Effect Combinations by Method
entries.summary: Lists which holy Powers can be activated by each of the three Methods.

entries.title: Effect Combinations by Power
entries.summary: Lists which holy Methods can activate each of the seven Powers.

entries.title: Creating New Powers and Effects
entries.summary: Advice for designing new holy effects from Hermetic guidelines or inventing a new Power.

entries.title: Shahada: Effect on Infernal Creatures
entries.summary: Speaking the Muslim testimony of faith aloud causes brief discomfort to Infernal creatures that hear it, and pain to a rare few that are especially vulnerable.
quotes: Any creature belonging to the Infernal realm who hears someone say the shahada out loud suffers momentary discomfort.

entries.title: Salat: Ritual Prayer Raises Dominion Aura
entries.requires: Muslim ritual prayer in an Islamic Dominion aura
entries.summary: Ritual prayer five times daily temporarily strengthens an Islamic Dominion aura while it is taking place.
quotes: Any Islamic Dominion aura in which ritual prayer (salat, not du'a') is taking place has its score raised by one for the duration of the prayer.

entries.title: Zakat: Alms-Tax and the Infernal
entries.summary: Infernal creatures cannot handle goods or money given as zakat without suffering great pain, until another person has touched them.
quotes: Creatures belonging to the Infernal realm may not handle money or goods if they are being physically given to them as payment of the zakat, and they suffer excruciating pain if they attempt to do so.

entries.title: Sawm: Ramadan Fast Raises Dominion Aura
entries.summary: Muslim Dominion auras are strengthened throughout the month of Ramadan, when Muslims fast.
quotes: The score of Muslim Dominion Auras increases by one during the month of Ramadan.

entries.title: The Muslim Calendar and Holiday Auras
entries.requires: Muslim Dominion aura during a Muslim holiday
entries.summary: Lists the months and holidays of the Muslim lunar calendar and gives the aura bonus for holidays, which stacks with the bonus from ritual prayer.
quotes: The scores of Muslim Dominion auras are increased by one during Muslim holidays.

entries.title: Hajj: Pilgrimage Rewards
entries.requires: Muslim character who completes the hajj
entries.summary: A Muslim completing the pilgrimage to Mecca gains a Pious Personality Trait and Faith Points, which can be regained by repeating the hajj but never raised above a cap.
quotes: A Muslim who has completed the hajj gains a Personality Trait of Pious +3
The Muslim also gains 3 Faith Points.

entries.title: Mosque Dominion Auras
entries.summary: Gives typical Dominion aura strengths for ordinary and famous mosques and notes that prayer or the Ramadan fast raises them further.
quotes: Most mosques have a Dominion aura of 4, while major, famous mosques will usually have auras of 5

entries.title: The Cave on Saint's Island (Empyreal aura and the gate to Purgatory)
entries.summary: Gives the Empyreal aura of the island, and explains how the canons ritually open the gate to Purgatory, including the casting bonus from the Ceremony Ability and who may follow a pilgrim through.
quotes: The aura on Inisnaoimh is an Empyreal aura of level 4.
He can rely on a Ceremony bonus to his casting total of at least +16

related.text: Realms of Power: the Divine p.7 Empyreal auras
Realms of Power: the Divine Revised Edition p.36 Ceremony

entries.title: Time in Purgatory
entries.summary: Describes how time passes in Purgatory and the Earthly Paradise, when characters return, and why aging is based on mundane time and experience cannot be gained from the differential.
quotes: Characters cannot use the differential passage of time to gain experience points

entries.title: The Vision of Hell (Regio crossing)
entries.summary: Describes the Divine and Tartaran regiones entered through Purgatory, the Ease Factors for crossing without a guide, and how to find a particular field of torment.
quotes: the Ease Factor for the Regio Sight roll is 33
an Intelligence + Theology against an Ease Factor of 9 reveals which fields punish which sins

entries.title: The Furnace (Insight and transmutation)
entries.requires: Access to the Furnace in Purgatory
entries.summary: The Furnace of Purgatory transmutes vis, enchanted devices and mortals' Virtues or Flaws into fiery equivalents, and offers Insight into original research on Limits of Essential Nature and Vis.
quotes: If vis of any Art is thrown into the Furnace it can be retrieved as Ignem vis.
The Furnace provides an insight towards the creation of a 50th level effect.

related.text: Realms of Power: the Infernal p.76 Xaphan

entries.title: The Mirror of Souls
entries.requires: Access to the Abyssal Pit in Purgatory
entries.summary: A scrying mirror that works on a name or any Sympathetic Connection, and a source of Insight for original research into the Limit of Arcane Connections or of the Infernal.
quotes: subsequent scrying does, using the Mirror's Penetration of 50
The Mirror provides an insight towards the creation of a 50th level effect.

entries.title: The Bridge to Paradise (crossing rolls)
entries.summary: Explains how characters cross the knife-thin bridge from Purgatory's Infernal regio to the Earthly Paradise, with successive Athletics rolls, a Regio Sight difficulty for non-walking routes, and what happens to those who fall.
quotes: must make three successive Dexterity + Athletics stress rolls of Ease Factors 6, 9, and 12
crossing in any other manner requires a Regio Sight roll of 37

related.text: ArM5 p.158 Piercing the Faerie Veil

entries.title: The Fountain of Youth
entries.requires: Access to the Fountain in Purgatory
entries.summary: A one-time-per-life fountain that removes Decrepitude or Warping, lowers Apparent Age, grants the Unaging Virtue, and also serves as an Insight source for the Limits of Aging or Warping.
quotes: A single mouthful can remove up to 3 points of Decrepitude (and associated aging points) or 3 points of Warping Score, or some combination of the two.
It is only possible to benefit from the Fountain's power once in a lifetime.

entries.title: Boosting Magical Auras
entries.summary: Introduces the ability of Hermetic Architecture to manipulate magical auras and regiones, which is normally beyond Hermetic magic and available only to those initiated in the Virtue.

entries.title: Increase of the Room's Modest Aura (sample enchantment)
entries.summary: Sample Architecture enchantment raising the magical aura of a room by one level up to a cap; shows the procedure for enchanting a room, with the magus's own lab enchanted in place and other rooms needing the full structural method.
quotes: Increases the Magical aura in a room by +1, to a maximum aura level of 5.
(Base 55, +1 Touch, +2 Room, +14 levels always on)

entries.title: Bountiful Boundary's Splendid Aura (sample enchantment)
entries.summary: Sample Architecture enchantment raising the aura of a standard Boundary by one level up to a cap, with its component, Geometry roll and binding level worked out.
quotes: Increases the Magical aura in a standard Boundary by +1, to a maximum aura level of 6.

entries.title: Enchantment of the Magnified Regio (sample enchantment)
entries.summary: Sample Architecture enchantment that doubles the size of a magical regio, up to a limit, using a ring of pillars set at the old and new perimeters.
quotes: Increases the size of a Magical regio, doubling its size to a maximum of 200 paces across.

entries.title: Closed Privacy of the Enchanted Regio (sample enchantment)
entries.summary: Sample Architecture enchantment that shrinks the interface between regio levels until it pinches off, so the inner level can no longer be walked into or seen from the adjacent one.
quotes: (Base 35, +1 Touch, +4 Boundary, +1 to affect the interface only, +14 levels always on)

entries.title: Conjunction of the Mystic Veils (sample enchantment)
entries.summary: Sample Architecture enchantment creating a password-opened gateway between two levels of a regio from four devices; each gate is one-way, and bidirectional travel needs two gates.
quotes: A single gateway allows travel in one direction only; to make a gate bidirectional, the caster needs two gates (eight component devices).

entries.title: Story Seeds for the Residue of Great Magic (Moving an Aura)
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Moving a site of great works usually leaves its aura behind, because the spirit of place is tied to the location; overcoming this needs a Rego Vim effect or requisite, usually a ritual opposed by the Spirit of Place.
quotes: the aura is usually left behind

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.106 Genius Loci

entries.title: Sources of Magic Auras
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Magic auras develop in four ways: through natural beauty, ancient structures, the residue of powerful rituals, and the habitation of magical creatures, which matters for an artificial island that starts without an aura.
quotes: Magic auras develop in four main ways.

entries.title: Natural Beauty (Aura Tether)
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Sites of great natural beauty can tether an aura; an uninhabited rock with an aura can be enclosed by the island, or a place of archetypal wind or wave action found nearby, giving only a weak tether.
quotes: Sites of great natural beauty can provide the tether for an aura.

entries.title: Ancient Structures (Aura Tether)
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Structures slowly acquire magical tethers, and can be moved to the island while retaining some of their potency.
quotes: each century adds 1 to the strength of the tether

entries.title: The Residue of Great Magic (Aura Tether)
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Rituals of sufficiently high level create magical tethers, but the rituals that build the wall and fill are normally too weak to do so unless the island is vast.
quotes: Magical tethers are created by rituals of level 45 or higher.

entries.title: The Lair of Great Magical Creatures (Aura Tether)
entries.requires: Saga arc: Island of the Magicians
entries.summary: Places where potent spirits dwell eventually develop auras, but such creatures prefer to move into an existing aura, so this method works best after another method has made a weak aura.
quotes: Places where potent spirits dwell eventually develop auras.

entries.title: Sympathy
entries.requires: Sympathy Trait (from a Virtue or Faerie Warping)
entries.summary: Introduces sympathy, the lingering connection to what a faerie represents that lets characters work Faerie hedge wizardry; it is not an Arcane Connection.
quotes: Sympathy represents a mystic relationship with a type of subject through the Faerie realm.

entries.title: Sympathy Traits
entries.requires: Sympathy Trait (from a Virtue or Faerie Warping)
entries.summary: Defines Sympathy Traits, which can act as a specialization bonus on non-Supernatural Abilities, and negative Traits that penalise Abilities and add botch dice.
quotes: you may add the value of the Sympathy Trait to the Ability instead of the +1 bonus for an applicable specialization
Negative Sympathy Traits also give the player a number of additional botch dice equal to the character's worst Trait on all botch rolls

entries.title: Increasing Sympathy Traits
entries.requires: Sympathy Trait (from a Virtue or Faerie Warping)
entries.summary: How Sympathy Traits grow with experience (limited by Warping Score), fluctuate on stress die results, and can be adjusted as story rewards.
quotes: Practicing a Sympathy Trait for a season yields 5 experience points towards that Trait.
so long as the value of the Trait does not exceed the character's Warping Score

entries.title: Faerie Rank
entries.requires: Sympathy Trait (from a Virtue or Faerie Warping)
entries.summary: Faerie Rank measures a character's overall connection to Faerie from the best positive and worst negative Sympathy Traits, and affects how faeries regard the character.
quotes: It is the value of the character's highest positive Sympathy Trait, modified by the character's lowest negative Sympathy Trait.

entries.title: Sympathetic Influence Table
entries.requires: Sympathy Trait (from a Virtue or Faerie Warping)
entries.summary: Table converting a sympathetic influence roll into the Sympathy Trait value gained.
quotes: +3 or –3 (max)

entries.title: Sympathetic Influence
entries.requires: Sympathy Trait (from a Virtue or Faerie Warping)
entries.summary: Procedure for temporarily gaining a Sympathy Trait by ceremonial or practical influence, using a Leadership roll tied to an appropriate Personality Trait.
quotes: a simple die + Presence + Leadership
Sympathy Traits gained through sympathetic influence cannot be increased with experience points

entries.title: Becoming a Saint
entries.requires: Troupe decision; character died with the Personality Trait Pious at the required level
entries.summary: Sets out the conditions under which a deceased character may become a genuine saint and, separately, be formally canonised by the Church, and points to the saint-design rules in Realms of Power: The Divine.
quotes: died with a Personality Trait Pious of 6 or higher

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.60-61 Miracles
Realms of Power: The Divine p.89 Designing saints

entries.title: Threatening a Saint
entries.summary: After failing to invoke a saint, a petitioner may threaten him with a Presence + Leadership roll against an Ease Factor based on the saint's Divine Might; Confidence but not Faith Points may be spent.
quotes: You make a Presence + Leadership + modifiers + stress die roll against an Ease Factor of 9 + one fifth of the saint's Divine Might.
THREATENING A SAINT: Presence + Leadership + modifiers + stress die vs. 9 + Saint's Divine Might/5

entries.title: Threat Modifiers and Outcomes
entries.summary: Table of modifiers for threatening a saint and the results: success grants the miracle, failure bars aid for a month, a big failure brings a minor curse and a season without aid, and a botch brings the curse.
quotes: If your roll is ten or more points beneath the Ease Factor the saint punishes you by inflicting a minor curse

entries.title: Saints' Powers list
entries.summary: List of miracle powers saints can use, each with a Might point cost, initiative modifier and Form, from Acknowledgment of Evil to Tomorrow's Bounty.
quotes: The Penetration of this miracle (Divine Might – (5 x Might Point cost of power))

entries.title: Saints' Curses list
entries.summary: List of curses saints can inflict on those who threaten their followers, each with Might cost, initiative and effect.

entries.title: The Guardians
entries.requires: Access to the Garden of Eden regio
entries.summary: Describes the layered Divine regio of Eden and the angelic guardians who bar humans, reptiles, faeries, demons and ghosts but admit animals, so characters can only pass by fully transforming into an animal shape and keeping it.
quotes: The regio has three levels.
Characters with Divine Might can enter and leave whenever they wish

entries.title: The Animals
entries.requires: Access to the Garden of Eden regio
entries.summary: Rules for life inside Eden: animals speak Adamic, Gifted magi in animal form lose their Gift and cannot cast or experiment, and learning Adamic from the animals is slow by Exposure but faster by Practice.
quotes: Magi who enter in animal form find that they no longer have The Gift while within the garden
they can begin to learn through Practice, which gives eight experience points per season

entries.title: The Fruits
entries.requires: Access to the Garden of Eden regio
entries.summary: Eating the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge or the Tree of Life expels the character permanently and transforms them, granting Intelligence or the Gift with Warping, or Magical Might after an Aging roll, and fixing them in animal form while barring their whole species.
quotes: All characters who partake of it gain an Intelligence score if they have Cunning, or gain The Gift if they are already intelligent.
He must make a successful Aging roll (one which does not cause him to gain an Aging Point) to wake up.
he has a Magical Might score equal to (10 – Size)

entries.title: Talking to the Animals
entries.requires: Access to the Garden of Eden regio
entries.summary: Clarifies that Eden's animals speak Adamic without having Intelligence scores, so language-comprehension magic needs an Animal requisite to make sense of them.
quotes: effects like the spell Thoughts Within Babble (InMe 25) do not make sense of the words the animals speak unless they are designed with an Animal requisite

entries.title: Illumination: Hyperborean Warping
entries.requires: Tradition: Hyperborean hymns (as first and primary magical tradition)
entries.summary: A Gifted character whose primary tradition is the hymns suffers Illumination in place of ordinary Warping or Hermetic Twilight; Hermetic magi are unaffected and still experience Twilight.
quotes: Illumination does not affect Hermetic magi, who always experience Twilight.

entries.title: Apollo's Light: Illumination Control roll
entries.summary: Warping gives a Hyperborean wizard an Apollonian Personality Trait; gaining several Warping Points at once forces an Illumination Control roll, and failure transforms the character into an animal or separates the spirit from the body.
quotes: Illumination Control Roll: Stamina + Concentration + highest Hymn Ability score + stress die
Illumination Ease Factor: character's updated Warping Score + number of Warping Points gained + aura + modifiers + stress die

entries.title: Illumination transformation and the Bright Lightening
entries.summary: What happens while an Illuminated character is transformed, the second Control roll needed to return to human form, and the voluntary Bright Lightening that trades extra Warping for experience in a hymn.
quotes: This transformation lasts for a number of hours equal to the total number of Warping Points the character has.

entries.title: Illumination Example
entries.summary: A worked example of an Illumination Control roll, including the effect of Descent and infused power levels, and of voluntarily failing the roll.
quotes: Abaris's Warping Score is 8 (223 Warping Points).

entries.title: Entering the Truffle Regio
entries.summary: How characters find and enter the truffle regio: it needs a guide or exact location, one character able to see the regio, and a local Magic aura that only exists on the solstices and equinoxes. Leaving is possible at any time.
quotes: The Magic aura outside of the regio is 1, only on the solstices and equinoxes, which means that the players must roll against an Ease Factor of 9 to see inside.

related.text: ArM5 p.189 entering and leaving regiones
ArM5 p.158 Piercing the Magical Veil

entries.title: Truffle Regio, first level (Regio Entrance)
entries.summary: Describes the outermost level of the regio, its Magic aura, how to spot the path leading onward, and how the Wild Boar of the Woods intercepts intruders and sends them after interloping wolves.
quotes: The first level of the regio has a Magic aura of 3.
With a Hunt + Perception roll against an Ease Factor of 9, the character notices a path leading away from the regio entrance.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.55 Creatures of Virtue

entries.title: Truffle Regio, second level (Truffle Fields)
entries.summary: Describes how to reach the second level of the regio, which has a stronger Magic aura, and what happens if the characters cannot see the way on and loop back to the first level.
quotes: The second level of the regio has a Magic aura of 5.

related.text: ArM5 p.158 Piercing the Magical Veil

entries.title: Truffle Regio, third level (Truffle Holt)
entries.summary: Describes how characters cross into the third and final level of the regio, which has the strongest Magic aura, with help from the truffle workers or by finding the entrance themselves.
quotes: The third and final level of the regio has a Magic aura of 7.

entries.title: The Corrupt Cluniacs
entries.requires: Saga option: the Cluniacs are Infernally corrupt
entries.summary: How to run the Cluniac order as the corrupt order in a saga: its history of corruption, the Goetic Favored Abilities and Supernatural Ability Corruption of its monks, profaned rites that create Infernal vis, Debauched Auras, and bound ghosts.
quotes: The corrupt Cluniacs have Favored Abilities of the Goetic Arts of Ablating, Binding, Commanding, and Summoning.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.14, 91, 96, 114-120

entries.title: The Corrupt Cistercians (Joachimite Illuminati)
entries.requires: Saga option: the Cistercians are Infernally corrupt
entries.summary: How to run the Cistercian order as the corrupt order: the Joachimite heresy and the secret Illuminati society inside the order, with its three informal degrees of initiation culminating in an inner circle that teaches Maleficia through an Unholy Tradition.
quotes: There are three degrees of initiation into the group, though these are not formal ranks as in a mystery cult.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.133
Realms of Power: The Infernal p.128

entries.title: If the Vallumbrosans are Corrupt
entries.requires: Saga option: the Vallumbrosans are Infernally corrupt
entries.summary: How to run the Vallumbrosans as a diabolist order: monks are worn down until they can be offered a pact, bargaining for Virtues or loss of Flaws, with a limited term to recruit a successor before the soul is claimed.
quotes: If they leave, they have seven years to find someone else to sign the pact, or they die, their soul claimed by hell.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.94

entries.title: Creating Divine Regiones
entries.requires: Divine creature with sufficient Divine Might
entries.summary: Rules for divine beings with enough Divine Might creating temporary Divine regiones, and the Might cost of sustaining them.
quotes: Divine beings with a Divine Might score of 20 or greater have the ability to create temporary Divine regiones of either kind.
The creature must spend at least 10 Divine Might points, which creates a single-level regio with a rating of 1.

entries.title: Spontaneous Regiones
entries.requires: A miracle, holy power or expenditure of Divine Might
entries.summary: Notes that powerful divine acts may create a temporary Divine regio, with no precise system beyond story needs.

entries.title: Celestial Regiones
entries.summary: A summary of the effects of Celestial regiones on visitors: a stress roll to act normally, Fatigue loss over time, Warping, and the resulting Ascent.
quotes: To act normally, a visitor must make a Stamina + Dominion Lore stress roll against an Ease Factor equal to (3 x aura).
Characters can spend 1 Faith Point to automatically succeed on the roll.

related.text: Realms of Power: the Divine pp.14-15 Celestial regiones
Realms of Power: the Divine p.63 Ascension

entries.title: Enriching a Beech Tree of Virtue
entries.requires: Setting: Trees of Virtue in the Truffle Regio (Mythic Locations)
entries.summary: Procedure for Enriching branches from a Beech Tree of Virtue into an amulet that temporarily grants the Luck Virtue, and the vis obtained from its beechnuts.
quotes: While the amulet is worn, the character is treated as having the Luck Virtue (ArM5, page 45).

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic Trees of Virtue

entries.title: Enriching a Poplar Tree of Virtue
entries.requires: Setting: Trees of Virtue in the Truffle Regio (Mythic Locations)
entries.summary: Procedure for Enriching leaves and twigs from a Poplar Tree of Virtue into a crown that briefly grants the Long-Winded Virtue to one wearer, plus the vis from perfect leaves.
quotes: The Enriched crown only grants the Long-Winded Virtue to one person

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic Trees of Virtue

entries.title: Truffles of Virtue
entries.summary: Explains how Truffles of Virtue are Enriched by being eaten by a Magic creature and propagated by fertilizing trees, and how they count as Dedicated vis if used another way.
quotes: Truffles of Virtue may be Enriched by being devoured by a creature with a Magic Might of at least 5.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.122 Dedicated vis

entries.title: Extraordinary Vis
entries.requires: Extraordinary vis found in powerful magical places
entries.summary: Rules for vis that carries a special power: how it is detected, investigated in the lab, and the limits on its effects, Range and pawn count.
quotes: A reasonable guideline is 1 pawn per 10 levels of the magical effect produced by the extraordinary vis.
the Laboratory Total to discover the vis' power and triggering event is equal to half the spell level of the spell-like vis.

entries.title: Lesser Enchantment Vis
entries.requires: Extraordinary vis of the lesser enchantment type
entries.summary: Extraordinary vis that emulates a lesser enchantment, designed like a normal lesser enchantment but free of the usual material and size limits; moving it to another object destroys its power.
quotes: This form of extraordinary vis emulates a lesser enchantment, usually level 30 or lower.

entries.title: Spell-like Vis
entries.requires: Extraordinary vis of the spell-like type
entries.summary: Extraordinary vis that mimics a high-level spell once, needs a triggering event, and is completely consumed by its effect.
quotes: Unlike lesser enchantment vis, spell-like vis cannot produce a continuous magical effect and is completely consumed at the end of the effect.

entries.title: The Triumphal Arch (entering the temple regio)
entries.summary: Explains the auras around the ruined arch and the regio behind it, and how the arch must be rebuilt (in any material) in the right astrological position and shape before the regio can be entered.
quotes: The area around the ruined triumphal arch, extending for about 100 paces, has a Magic aura of 1.
The regio behind the triumphal arch has a Magic aura of 5.
Intelligence + Artes Liberales (astronomy) roll against an Ease Factor of 9

entries.title: The Town Beyond the Arch (regio layout and exits)
entries.summary: Describes the self-wrapping town regio and its exits, including that the regio arch must stand to leave by it and that Leap of Homecoming-type effects work regardless.
quotes: The town occupies the entire regio and it wraps around itself

entries.title: The Necropolis Regio
entries.summary: Describes an optional dark-mirror regio into which characters who die in the temple regio pass as ghosts, and how ghosts may cross its boundary.
quotes: The necropolis regio (Magic aura 7)

entries.title: Invocation (Holy Method)
entries.summary: The Holy Method of calling on God's power with spoken or written prayer, costing Confidence or Faith and optionally using a stress die.
quotes: This adds Communication to your roll, and requires that you spend a point of Confidence (or Faith) to bring the effect into being.

entries.title: Meditation (Holy Method)
entries.summary: The Holy Method of achieving ecstasy through chanting or performance, with periodic Stamina rolls and a defence against Divine Ascent.
quotes: you must make a Stamina roll every ten minutes against an Ease Factor of 6
You may subtract your score in Meditation from your roll to avoid Divine Ascent

entries.title: Purity (Holy Method)
entries.summary: The Holy Method of working miracles through strenuous effort, and the rule for extending any holy ritual over hours, days or weeks to spend more Confidence or Faith.
quotes: You must engage in an activity that is strenuous enough to cause you to lose a long-term Fatigue level or suffer a Light Wound, and you use your Stamina for your effect roll.

entries.title: Cursewood: Malevolent Infernal aura effects
entries.summary: Lists the game effects of the aura of 5 in the Cursewood, a Malevolent Infernal aura: penalties to wound Recovery, added Damage, extra botch dice on physical activities and reopening of demon-caused wounds.
quotes: Wounds suffer a penalty to Recovery rolls equal to the aura rating of 5 while inside.
All physical activities suffer 5 additional botch dice from the aura; this includes all rolls for trek progress.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.12-14 Malevolent auras

entries.title: Cursewood: De-Corrupting the Vis
entries.summary: Tainted vis stays corrupted, but once the Magic aura dominates again, and after a year free of Infernal influence, newly produced vis is clean.
quotes: After a full year with no Infernal influence, all vis sources are free from corruption.

entries.title: Cursewood variant: Dark Faerie Aura
entries.summary: Variant in which a faerie aura rather than an Infernal one produces the same added botch dice, damage and ability penalties, but these effects must penetrate and use the faerie's Might.
quotes: faerie powers and illusions result in the same effects as the Malevolent Infernal aura in the form of added botch dice, added damage, and penalties to Abilities and magic.

entries.title: Invoking Muslim Holy Forbears (Baraka)
entries.requires: Muslim character in a Dominion setting
entries.summary: Muslims seek baraka from venerated figures by reusing the Christian saint-invocation mechanics, with changes: they must be at the figure's shrine, may always invoke the Qur'an, and never threaten forbears.
quotes: Muslim characters may attempt to invoke baraka from holy forbears using the same mechanics as those given above for invoking Christian saints
Muslims may always invoke the power of the Qur'an, no matter where they are.
Muslims never threaten their holy forbears.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine, Mythic Christianity, Saints

entries.title: Muslim Invocation Modifiers Table
entries.summary: Table of situational modifiers applied to a Muslim's attempt to invoke baraka from a holy forbear, covering Personality Trait, aura, feast days, relics, donations, peril and sins.
quotes: Highest Muslim Personality Trait | + value of the Trait
No zakat paid within a year | –3

entries.title: Khawass al-Qur'an (Invoking the Qur'an)
entries.summary: The Qur'an itself acts as a holy figure that can be invoked anywhere, using the same method as a forbear, to gain earthly benefits from recitation.
quotes: In game terms, the Qur'an itself may be invoked in the same way as a forbear, in an attempt to gain earthly benefits.

entries.title: En-Dor Regio Level One
entries.summary: First regio level of En-Dor: a Divine aura swamps a lesser Magic aura, and a magical stream gives a Longevity Ritual effect while in the regio, forces an Aging roll on leaving, and yields tainted Aquam vis.
quotes: acts like a +5 Longevity Ritual (ArM5, page 101)

entries.title: En-Dor Regio Level Two
entries.summary: Second regio level of En-Dor: a strong Magic aura, a valley that cannot be left except through the cave, and a city of the dead that is a suitable covenant site.

entries.title: Mystics (female religious)
entries.requires: Visions Flaw, or True Faith with the Understanding power
entries.summary: Explains how to represent a religious mystic in game terms: usually the Visions Flaw, or occasionally True Faith with Understanding and Meditation. Also covers how a bishop's (or pope's) acceptance of a nun's visions earns her a Reputation as a mystic.
quotes: In most case, the experiences of a religious mystic are covered by the Visions Flaw.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine pp.34, 36, 37, 54

entries.title: False Visions
entries.summary: Guidance for storyguides on non-divine sources of apparent visions (Spirits of Deceit, deluded or feigning individuals, Magic auras, faeries) and on the difficulty of proving a vision genuine, including a magus investigating inside a Dominion aura.
quotes: It can be very difficult to prove whether or not a particular mystical experience is genuinely divine.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.38

entries.title: Insight of the Realms (Realm Lore in ceremonial totals, regio detection)
entries.requires: Virtue: Insight of the Realms (Hermetic, researched or integrated)
entries.summary: Lets a maga substitute the matching Realm Lore Ability for Artes Liberales or Philosophiae in ritual and ceremonial casting totals within or related to that realm, and use Realm Lore to detect and see through a regio boundary in place of Second Sight or Sense Holiness & Unholiness.
quotes: may substitute the appropriate Realm Lore Ability for either Artes Liberales or Philosophiae in any ritual or ceremonial spell totals cast within or related to the matching realm

entries.title: True Understanding of the Realms (reducing foreign aura levels)
entries.requires: Virtue: True Understanding of the Realms (Hermetic)
entries.summary: Her Realm Lore scores reduce the effective level of a foreign supernatural aura, lowering the realm interaction penalty, extra botch dice, and aura side effects, and also help the penetration of enchanted devices. Includes how it interacts with the sigil, talismans, and the cost to integrate, with a worked example.
quotes: the effective level of that aura is reduced by the score in the appropriate Realm Lore Ability to a minimum of 0
it takes 30 points to integrate or research this virtue, otherwise it takes 45 points.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal p.16

entries.title: Devil's Lane Faerie Regio (the Streets)
entries.summary: Describes the layout of the toy market regio and gives its Faerie aura.
quotes: The entire market is a Faerie regio (aura level 6).

entries.title: The Alley Wards
entries.summary: Explains the faerie wards on the regio entrances that block humans without faerie blood, what they do not stop, how they read to Intellego Vim, and that dispelled wards return at dawn or dusk.
quotes: The alley wards have no Penetration, and thus do not keep out most magi (or others with Magic Resistance).
if dispelled the wards reappear at the next dawn or dusk (whichever is next)

entries.title: Faerie Warping
entries.requires: Supernatural powers aligned to the Faerie realm
entries.summary: Gives the pattern by which Faerie-aligned characters respond to Warping at each Warping Score, developing a glamour (a Reputation Flaw), a need to act on it or suffer Deprivation, Sympathy Traits, Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: The character must act in a manner concordant with his Reputation at least once a season, or else he suffers the effects of Deprivation

entries.title: Sources of Faerie Warping
entries.summary: Lists how Warping Points are gained from faerie sources: the Faerie realm, powerful Faerie auras and regiones, faerie powers, and botches.
quotes: One Warping Point is gained for every botch die that comes up a zero when using faerie powers or supernatural effects aligned to the Faerie realm.

entries.title: Infernal Influence
entries.summary: Infernalists inspire temporary sinful Personality Traits in willing followers through a season of personal influence or a short ceremony, with the strength set by a Presence + Leadership roll.
quotes: simple die + Presence + Leadership
Infernal Influence: simple die + Presence + Leadership
traits gained from personal influence can linger as long as a year, while those from ceremonial influence usually fade within about a week

entries.title: Tarnish
entries.summary: Infernalists tarnish an Infernal aura by giving it a sinful Personality Trait, using a stress roll on Presence + Leadership; the tarnish fades over time.
quotes: Tarnishing an aura: stress die + Presence + Leadership
its value decreases by one each morning

entries.title: Becoming Infernal
entries.summary: Explains how a being with another realm's Might can become Infernal, with its Might converting to Infernal Might, and why the reverse is rare.
quotes: when a character with Divine, Faerie, or Magic Might becomes an infernalist, her Might Score becomes Infernal Might instead

entries.title: Infernal Hierarchy and Reputation
entries.summary: Introduces Infernal Reputations, the starting Infernal Reputation of level 1 and the Hierarchy Score used in Infernal Power formulas.
quotes: This is simply the same as the score of the highest Reputation possessed by the character.
may begin with an appropriate Infernal Reputation of level 1

entries.title: The Grand Master's Commanding Aura
entries.requires: Holding the office of Templar grand master
entries.summary: The office of Templar grand master bestows the Commanding Aura Virtue on its holder, treated as spiritually equal to an archbishop.
quotes: The grand master, as a position appointed by God, is the spiritual equivalent to an Archbishop, with a Magic Resistance of 10.

entries.title: The Grand Master's Seal
entries.requires: Holding the office of Templar grand master
entries.summary: The grand master's seal is a Divine relic with its own Faith Score and Divine Might, which also adds extra Magic Resistance against effects tied to one particular sin.
quotes: The seal has a Faith Score of 1, granting it a Divine Might of 10.

entries.title: Muslim Birth Rituals and True Names
entries.summary: Muslim birth rituals protect a child's name from being used as a True Name in supernatural activities, just as Christian baptism does.
quotes: The rituals associated with the birth have the effect of rendering the child's name unusable as a True Name in supernatural activities

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine, baptism and True Names

entries.title: Muslim Funerals and Summoning Ghosts
entries.summary: Properly buried Muslims wait in their graves until the Last Judgment, so only Muslim ghosts lacking a funeral can be magically summoned, and prophets and martyrs cannot be summoned at all.
quotes: This means that only Muslim ghosts that have not been given a Muslim funeral may be summoned to the world of the living by magic.

entries.title: Relics
entries.summary: Every relic has Faith giving Confidence-like Faith Points and Magic Resistance, a Divine Might limiting uses of its powers, and a power that repels Infernal creatures.
quotes: A relic's Divine Might is equal to the relic's Faith score (or highest Faith score, if more than one applies) multiplied by 10, and the Might Pool is refreshed with every sunrise.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine Revised Edition, pp.88-89

entries.title: Jewish Ritual Objects as Relics
entries.summary: Describes Jewish sacred objects and notes the circumstances in which tefillin and the shofar count as relics with a Faith Point, and when they have no power.
quotes: When it is sounded on a holy day or as part of a Jewish exorcism rite, the shofar is treated as a relic with one Faith Point.
those once owned by one of the Tzadikim Nistarim (see later) act as a relic with one Faith Point.

entries.title: Creo-aligned aura of the Truffle Regio
entries.summary: Explains the effects of a Creo-aligned Magic aura: doubled aura bonus for Creo activities, aura added to Recovery rolls, cheaper Might for Creo creatures, instant healing of minor hurts, slowed apparent aging and a Living Conditions bonus for a full year.
quotes: The Magic aura bonus is doubled in the regio for all activities involving Creo.
For each season the character spends in the aura, his apparent age is decreased by one, but does not decrease below 27.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.16 aligned auras

entries.title: Weakening an Aura Through Hermetic Viresculture
entries.summary: Optional interaction with Aura Variation: pawns harvested through Viresculture lower the Yearly Aura Modifier of the aura they grew in.
quotes: Yearly Aura Modifier for Viresculture: – (total pawns / 5)

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.10 Aura Variation

entries.title: Awakened Trees
entries.summary: Trees in Magic auras are awake, with wakefulness rising with aura strength, and have Cunning instead of Intelligence and no Might score.
quotes: In an aura of level 6 or higher, the trees are fully awake and can see and hear about as well as a human can.

related.text: ArM5 p.137 Stir the Slumbering Tree

entries.title: The Basilica's Aura
entries.requires: Visiting the Basilica of Ten Thousand Columns
entries.summary: The varying Magic aura levels across the vale and buildings, the waxing and waning with the moon, small Dominion and Divine auras, and a doubling of aura benefit for certain spirit, divination and disease magic.
quotes: any spells cast or supernatural abilities used that relate to the summoning or control of the dead, divining the future, curing or causing disease, or invoking spirits receive double the benefit from the magical aura.

entries.title: Templars Calling on God's Aid
entries.summary: Templars routinely petition God's aid before battle, led by a brother-priest or, lacking one, the commanding Templar, using the Divine rules for calling on God's aid.
quotes: The Templar commander (or ranking Templar) may also call on God's aid if there is no brother-priest.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine pp.41-42

entries.title: The City of Luz (Celestial Regio)
entries.summary: A Divine regio where those inside do not die; it explains how to summon a pathway to it, how recovery rolls and aging behave inside, and the penalty for leaving after a long stay.
quotes: It takes a Purity (or Merkavah) + Intervention miraculous effect of base 35 to summon a pathway to the city gates
any rolls of 0 or less impose an Aging Point in any physical Characteristic

entries.title: Ceremony (group prayer)
entries.summary: Lets a group pray together to boost a focus character's holy effect, with a group modifier based on participants' Ceremony scores, with or without a leader.
quotes: GROUP MODIFIER: total Ceremony scores – number of participants

entries.title: Changing an aura (reducing Infernal, raising Magic)
entries.summary: How a corrupting Infernal aura fades once its focus is removed and the Magic aura dominates, and how a Magic aura can be raised with a yearly stress roll and bonuses from magical activities.
quotes: the Infernal aura drops by 1 after a number of years equal to its strength
A stress roll made once per year against an Ease Factor of 15 is needed for a permanent increase of 1.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.10-11

entries.title: Exorcism (Christian rite)
entries.summary: Describes how the Christian exorcism rite works mechanically: it either lets the possessed roll to shake off a resistible power or is a prayer for a miracle, costs a Confidence or Faith point, and gains bonuses from holy items and extra Faith points.
quotes: The rite costs the exorcist a Confidence (or Faith) point to perform properly.
each gives a +1 to the possessed character's total

entries.title: Ritual of passing on the power
entries.summary: The optional ritual by which the She-Wolf endows a petitioner, which also gives the spirit an Arcane Connection and sympathetic connections to the recipient.
quotes: This ritual is not strictly necessary, but it provides an appropriate amount of mystery and formality to the seeking of vengeance.

entries.title: Dealing with Wyzwanie (research the artifact)
entries.summary: How the forest daimon bargains once the magi reach him, including a season of research against an Ease Factor to learn how to cleanse the Infernal artifact and the benefits of lasting friendship.
quotes: may roll Intelligence + Infernal or Dominion Lore versus an Ease Factor of 12 for a season of study with an appropriate selection of books.

related.text: Guardians of the Forests Nature Lore

entries.title: Demons, Auras and Regiones
entries.summary: How quickly Infernal creatures regain Might: at a constant daily rate normally, faster in an Infernal aura, and not at all in a Divine aura.
quotes: NUMBER OF HOURS TO RESTORE ALL MIGHT: 24 - (2 x Infernal Aura)
MIGHT POINTS RESTORED PER HOUR: Infernal Might / Number of hours
A demon cannot regenerate any Might in a Divine aura.

entries.title: Miracles
entries.summary: Miracles are direct divine intervention and cannot fail or be resisted.
quotes: As such, they can do anything, cannot fail, and cannot be resisted by any other power.

entries.title: Mitigation of Realm Interaction Effects (Entreat the Powers)
entries.requires: Virtue: Entreat the Powers or Entreat the (Realm) Powers
entries.summary: How learned magicians call on realm powers to reduce negative realm interaction in hostile auras: the Entreat the Powers Total, its cap, entreating multiple realms and the botch penalty, with examples.
quotes: Stress Die + Presence + (Realm) Lore

entries.title: Cherem and Karet (Jewish Excommunication)
entries.summary: Describes the two Halakhic forms of excommunication, cherem (civic ostracism) and the more serious karet (spiritual death), including that karet victims are treated as excommunicates and how either can be lifted.
quotes: Characters punished through karet are treated as excommunicates as described in Chapter Four.
The Talmud identifies 24 crimes that may be punished by cherem.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine, Chapter Four (excommunication)

entries.title: Living in the Story (Becoming Faerie)
entries.requires: Long stay in Faerie; Mystery Virtue: Becoming (House Merinita)
entries.summary: A character who stays in Faerie may eventually become a faerie; no mechanic is given, but the Becoming Mystery Virtue covers it and the process typically starts after years at a high fable score.
quotes: after several years pass since gaining a fable score of 10

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults pp.93-96 Becoming

entries.title: Open Body: Arcane Connections to Faeries
entries.summary: Speaking to, eating the food of, bleeding near, or having sex with a faerie opens a human to its glamour and creates a temporary Arcane Connection with a stated Penetration multiplier; pregnancy by a faerie creates a longer-lasting one.
quotes: Speaking to a faerie creates an Arcane Connection to that faerie with a Penetration multiplier of 2 that endures until the conversation ends.
A character whose blood is taken or tasted by a faerie has an Arcane Connection to that Faerie with a Penetration multiplier of 3 until the wound heals.
Intercourse with a faerie creates an Arcane Connection to that faerie with a Penetration multiplier of 4 during the intercourse.

related.text: Chapter 3: Faerie Characters, Traditional and Sovereign Wards

entries.title: Faerie Calling
entries.requires: Faerie Rank and Sympathy Traits, with no magical, divine or infernal tradition
entries.summary: Procedure for the dreamlike Faerie Calling that occurs when a faerie-aligned character gains two or more Warping Points at once: acting during the Calling, designing setting and conflict, a resolution roll, and its effects on Sympathy Traits or permanent departure to Faerie.
quotes: Act During Faerie Calling: stress die + Perception + Awareness vs. ((Warping Score + Warping Points gained) x 3)
Resolve the Faerie Calling: stress die + Perception + Concentration vs. (Warping Score – Faerie Rank) x 3

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine p.63 Divine Ascent
Realms of Power: The Infernal p.95 Vituperation

entries.title: Faerie Virtues and Flaws
entries.summary: Explains that a Supernatural Virtue can be designated as having a Faerie origin, which gives it the Faerie bonuses on the Realm Interaction Table and spares the character Warping from living in a Faerie aura; notes Benediction and Malediction as typical faerie gifts and curses.
quotes: characters with a Faerie Virtue or Flaw do not gain Warping from living in a Faerie aura.

related.text: ArM5 pp.54-55 Greater and Lesser Malediction

entries.title: False Gift (False Magic)
entries.requires: Virtue: False Gift; Flaw: False Power
entries.summary: Explains the Infernally corrupted Gift: it carries the usual social penalties, its Supernatural Abilities are False Powers, Warping causes Vituperation instead of Twilight, and confessing and being absolved removes the Gift.
quotes: When exposed to Warping, instead of experiencing Twilight, a character with the False Gift must undergo Vituperation.
The False Gift has no cost, like its magical counterpart, though it requires the False Power Flaw

entries.title: False Power (Flaw)
entries.summary: Extended rules for a Supernatural Virtue that is also tainted by the Infernal, including how it reads to investigation, optional treatment as an Infernal Power, repentance, and taking the Flaw several times.
quotes: using the Infernal Power column of the realm interaction chart

entries.title: Entering the Temple of Serapis
entries.summary: The lost temple's regio is accessible only when the local Dominion aura drops below a threshold; characters carrying a mechanica enter automatically, and the window closes after a few hours.
quotes: When the Dominion aura dips below 4, the doorway to the Temple of Serapis appears as a ghostly archway of shadows beneath the lintel.

entries.title: Holy Influence (Rabbis and Chief Rabbis)
entries.requires: Rabbi, Chief Rabbi or Exilarch with spiritual authority
entries.summary: Explains which Jewish leaders hold spiritual authority and may exert Holy Influence, including tempering an aura, and over what area or community each can do so.
quotes: Rabbis have spiritual authority over the auras centered upon and the community served by their synagogue or yeshivah, while Chief Rabbis may extend their influence across their city.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine, Chapter Three (tempering auras)

entries.title: Hyperborea as a regio
entries.summary: Describes Hyperborea as an island in a multi-level regio that cannot be entered by accident (passwords or an invitation are needed), its inhabitants' Supernatural Powers, and Apollo's visit every nineteen years; includes sidebars on famous Hyperboreans and how to get in.
quotes: Hyperborea is an island hidden in a level 7 regio (although at its highest level it extends to a level 10 regio).

entries.title: Destroying an Infernal artifact permanently
entries.summary: An Infernal artifact that can reform is permanently destroyed only in a place with a strong Dominion aura by an ordained cleric with True Faith spending a Faith Point after hours of prayer.
quotes: it needs to be taken to a cathedral or other place with a Dominion aura of at least 5.

entries.title: Tartaran Regiones
entries.summary: A summary of the effects of hellfire in Tartaran regiones: no Fatigue recovery, added fire damage, and a damage bonus based on the victim's sinful Traits.
quotes: No Fatigue levels can be recovered within the regio, and all Fatigue levels lost are Long-Term Fatigue.
Add sum of the sinful Personality Traits to all fire or heat Damage Totals, counting negative virtuous traits as sinful.

related.text: Realms of Power: the Infernal p.16 Tartaran regiones

entries.title: Mortuary Masses
entries.summary: Describes the Infernal perversion of a funeral Mass said for a living person, which is held to cause death and is treated as murder.
quotes: It is widely believed that if a funeral Mass is celebrated for a man or woman still living, he will die.

entries.title: Farne Islands: Big Harcar (Magic Realm vestige)
entries.summary: An island that is a tether and level 4 vestige to a being in the Aquam province of the Twilight Void, noticed with a Perception + Awareness roll, and acting as a gateway for Aquam-aligned Magic creatures.
quotes: Big Harcar is a vestige of level 4, and for creatures with a Magic Might aligned to Aquam it acts as a gateway into the Magic Realm.
To see these features requires a Perception + Awareness simple roll of against an Ease Factor of 12; the character gets a +3 bonus if someone who has seen the oddities is pointing them out to him.

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic pp.22-28 vestiges and magical travel

entries.title: Magic Resistance For Church Officers and Sovereigns
entries.summary: Sidebar giving ordained and anointed leaders Magic Resistance by rank, a Soak bonus derived from it, and the effect of excommunication.
quotes: The religious and secular leaders listed below receive a Magic Resistance score as listed here, and a Soak bonus equal to Magic Resistance / 5.

entries.title: History Unfolding (tempora and temporary Personality Traits)
entries.summary: Describes the rules for the Magic Realm vestiges, where non-Magical characters gain a temporary Personality Trait, and the Ease Factor for magical travel between them.
quotes: characters gain the specified temporary Personality Trait of +3 while they remain within the tempus
each vestige has a level of 5, for an Ease Factor of 15 to travel to the next tempus

related.text: Realms of Power: Magic p.23 Magical Travel

entries.title: Spirits as a Source of Vis
entries.summary: Explains how much raw vis a spirit contains, when it can be distilled after the spirit is slain, and the vis from corporeal bodies and Presence.
quotes: typically 1 pawn of an appropriate Form per magnitude of their Might

entries.title: Waste
entries.summary: Describes the uncultivated waste of a manor as faerie domain outside the blessed fields, with clearing land spreading the Dominion.
quotes: The wasteland is the domain of the faeries.

entries.title: Characters with Might Scores
entries.summary: Sets out what beings with a Might score cannot take (Virtues from another realm), how Magic Resistance from several sources combines, and their immunity to Warping and realm backlashes.
quotes: No being with a Might score can have Virtues which affiliate them to another realm
these totals do not stack
Characters with a Might score are immune to all Warping

entries.title: Pilgrimage & Devotion
entries.summary: Gives the Devotion Points a Devoted character earns for pilgrimage to a saint's shrine and for further relevant sites and relics seen along the way.

entries.title: Entering the Garden of the Hesperides
entries.summary: How characters enter the regio hiding the Garden, its Magic aura, the restriction on entering while facing east, and the effects of the golden apples (a pawn of Creo vis and a reduction in Apparent Age).
quotes: The regio has a Magic aura of 9.
Each apple contains a pawn of Creo vis.

entries.title: Bear Island: Entering the regiones and Regio Sight ease factors
entries.summary: How to enter the Faerie regio by ritual and how to find either regio by spell or Regio Sight roll, with Ease Factors that change depending on which aura currently dominates.
quotes: Under the Temenos of Dindyméné's Magic aura, the Ease Factor to see the Magic regio is 11 and to see the Faerie regio is 23.
When the temenos has a Faerie aura of 4, the Ease Factor to see the Magic regio is 25 and to see the Faerie regio is 9.

entries.title: Jailbreak (Retrieving Souls from Purgatory)
entries.summary: Guidance on whether and how characters might bring a soul out of Purgatory or the Earthly Paradise and restore it to life, including which souls are eligible and the need for a body.
quotes: only the not completely good or not completely evil are eligible

entries.title: Spiritual Pact (Major Supernatural Virtue)
entries.summary: Extended rules for a character bound by pact to a Magic spirit: spending a Confidence Point to draw a temporary Might pool, how Penetration and duration work, the lack of a Might score, and how the spirit's own pool is reduced.
quotes: Make a Presence + Magic Lore + stress die roll: this is the amount of Magic Might Pool that the character acquires from his spiritual master.
A character can only have a single pact.

entries.title: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
entries.summary: Divine Supernatural Ability to feel good and evil, with different Ease Factors for an area, a person or object, a demon and a hidden angel.
quotes: A Perception + Sense Holiness and Unholiness roll against an Ease Factor of 9 lets you sense holiness or unholiness in a general area; against an Ease Factor of 15, in a person or object.

entries.title: The Mother Road
entries.requires: Faerie Portage, or House Merinita Wayfarers
entries.summary: A traveler stepping onto a trod can bargain with the Guardian to enter Faerie and exit at another trod, covering great distances quickly but without gaining fable points and relying on the Guardian for the way out.
quotes: typically one minute passes for every 24 minutes spent in the Faerie Realm

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults p.80 Wayfarers

entries.title: Town Defenses and Relic Processions
entries.summary: Describes town walls and gates, and notes that a procession of saints' relics around a threatened town counts as ceremonial influence on a Divine aura.
quotes: This counts as ceremonial influence tempering the aura to Loyal, Calm, or Brave

related.text: Realms of Power: The Divine pp.38-40

entries.title: Vituperation
entries.summary: The backlash an infernalist faces after gaining Warping Points or losing control of Infernal power: a resistance roll, a possible spell in Hell lasting by Warping Score, an Aging roll including Warping Score, and possible Confidence gains.
quotes: Warping Score + Number of Warping Points gained + Hierarchy Score + local aura + stress die (no botch)
Aging Roll: stress die (no botch) + (age / 10, rounded up) – living conditions modifier + Warping Score

entries.title: Divine Warping from Botches
entries.summary: Using a holy power or divine supernatural ability gives Warping Points based on zeros rolled on a botch die.
quotes: One Warping Point is gained for each zero on a botch die when using a holy power or divine supernatural ability.

entries.title: The Wolf's Court aura and the She-Wolf's manifestation
entries.summary: Gives the Magic aura of the Wolf's Court and describes how the She-Wolf forms a body, assesses petitioners without negotiation and speaks with her Voice of the Wolf power.
quotes: The Wolf's Court itself is situated in a Magic aura of 5.
